name: Kuzunoi Takatora
source:
He has a history of his mother leaving him due to an affair,
and he harbors intense possessive feelings toward girls.

Although he appears quite naive on the surface, he thinks strategically and has keen observational skills,
which he put to good use on the soccer field (he was skilled enough to be a regular player).

He also strongly dislikes being called a “loser” because of his last name.
